importance: population(region)/sample_N(region); applied to Mask and source pixel depth weighting
miss_policy: NaN depth, no zero regression, fixed positive Mask term retained, per-source miss denominator printed
source_beta_policy: beta_mm=beta_network*mm_per_network_unit; 0.08mm is analytic-control beta, not official model initialization
background_policy: cached point depth gives only same-source observed free-space bound; no real opaque BG mesh is certified
M3: M1+qualified visible Ring CAD pixel axial-Z
M4: M2 switch F1/F2/F3, three mutually exclusive bounded profiles
CAD_visible_pixel_rule: source Ring Mask2 + finite CAD firsthit + source native-Z agreement <=max(0.5mm,3 footprints); never overwrite Polyp Mask1
